paite: Hiaite Israel tapate ahi uh: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issakar, Zebulun;
heading: Israel Suante
english: These are the sons of Israel: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Zebulun,

paite: Dan, Joseph, Benjamin, Naphtali, Gad leh Asher.
english: Dan, Joseph, Benjamin, Naphtali, Gad, and Asher.

paite: Judah tapate: Er, Onan leh Shelah; huaite Shuah tanu Kanaan nu a kipan amah lak a piang thumte ahi uh. Huan TOUPA mitmuh in Judah ta masapen Er agi kei a; amah athat hi.
english: The sons of Judah: Er, Onan, and Shelah, which three were born to him of Shua’s daughter the Canaanitess. Er, Judah’s firstborn, was wicked in Yahweh’s sight; and he killed him.

paite: Huchi in Tamar atapa zi in Perez leh Zerah asuansak hi. Judah tapate tengteng nga ahi uh.
english: Tamar his daughter-in-law bore him Perez and Zerah. All the sons of Judah were five.

paite: Perez tapate: Hezron leh Hamul ahi uh.
english: The sons of Perez: Hezron and Hamul.

paite: Huan Zerah tapate: Zimri, Ethan, Heman, Kalkol leh Dara: avek un nga ahi uh.
english: The sons of Zerah: Zimri, Ethan, Heman, Calcol, and Dara—five of them in all.

paite: Huan Karmi tapate: Akar, thil siangthou a talekpa, Israel hihbuaipa.
english: The son of Carmi: Achar, the troubler of Israel, who committed a trespass in the devoted thing.

paite: Huan Ethan tapa Azariah ahi.
english: The son of Ethan: Azariah.

paite: Hezron, amah lak a piangte leng; Jerahmeel, Ram leh Kelubai.
heading: Kumpipa David Khanggui
english: The sons also of Hezron, who were born to him: Jerahmeel, Ram, and Chelubai.

paite: Huan Ram in Amminadab asuang a; Amminadab in Nahson, Judah suante lal asuang hi.
english: Ram became the father of Amminadab, and Amminadab became the father of Nahshon, prince of the children of Judah;

paite: Nahson in Salma asuang a, Salma in Boaz asuang;
english: and Nahshon became the father of Salma, and Salma became the father of Boaz,

paite: Boaz in Obed asuang a, Obed in Jesse asuang hi.
english: and Boaz became the father of Obed, and Obed became the father of Jesse;

paite: Jesse in ata masapen Eliab, anihna Abinadab leh athumna Shimea asuang;
english: and Jesse became the father of his firstborn Eliab, Abinadab the second, Shimea the third,

paite: alina Nethaneel, angana Raddai;
english: Nethanel the fourth, Raddai the fifth,

paite: agukna Ozem, asagihna David.
english: Ozem the sixth, and David the seventh;

paite: Huan asanggamnute uh Zeruiah leh Abigail ahi uh. Huchi in Zeruiah tapate: Abishai, Joab leh Asahel, thum ahi uh.
english: and their sisters were Zeruiah and Abigail. The sons of Zeruiah: Abishai, Joab, and Asahel, three.

paite: Abigail in Amasa asuang a, huan Amasa pa Ishmael mi Jether ahi.
english: Abigail bore Amasa; and the father of Amasa was Jether the Ishmaelite.

paite: Huan Jezron tapa Kaleb in Azubah azi leh Jerioth lak ah tate asuang a; hiaite atapate ahi: Jesher leh Shobab leh Ardon.
heading: Hezron Suante
english: Caleb the son of Hezron became the father of children by Azubah his wife, and by Jerioth; and these were her sons: Jesher, Shobab, and Ardon.

paite: Azubah asi a, Kaleb in amah a ding in Ephrath api a, huai in Hur aneihsak hi.
english: Azubah died, and Caleb married Ephrath, who bore him Hur.

paite: Hur in Uri asuang a, Uri in Bezaleel asuang hi.
english: Hur became the father of Uri, and Uri became the father of Bezalel.

paite: Huai nung in Gilead pa Makir tanu kiang ah Hezron alut a; huai zi dia api lai in kum sawmguk a upa ahi; ama'n Segub asuansak hi.
english: Afterward Hezron went in to the daughter of Machir the father of Gilead, whom he took as wife when he was sixty years old; and she bore him Segub.

paite: Segub in, Gilead gam a khopi sawmnih-le-thum nei Jair, asuansak hi.
english: Segub became the father of Jair, who had twenty-three cities in the land of Gilead.

paite: Ama'n amau a kipan Kenath leh huai a khoneite, khopi sawmguk toh Geshur, Aramin leh Jair khuate ala hi. Hiaite tengteng Gilead pa Makir tapate a ahi uh.
english: Geshur and Aram took the towns of Jair from them, with Kenath, and its villages, even sixty cities. All these were the sons of Machir the father of Gilead.

paite: Huai nung in Kaleb-ephrathah ah Hezron asi a, huchi in Hezron zi Abia in Tekoa pa Ashur asuansak hi.
english: After Hezron died in Caleb Ephrathah, Abijah, Hezron’s wife, bore him Ashhur the father of Tekoa.

paite: Huan Hezron ta masapen Jerahmeel tapate: ata masapen Ram, Bunah, Oren, Ozem leh Ahijah ahi uh.
heading: Jerahmeel Suante
english: The sons of Jerahmeel the firstborn of Hezron were Ram the firstborn, Bunah, Oren, Ozem, and Ahijah.

paite: Jerahmeel in zi dang anei a, amin Atarah ahi; amah Onam nu ahi.
english: Jerahmeel had another wife, whose name was Atarah. She was the mother of Onam.

paite: Jerahmeel ta masapen Ram tapate Maaz, Jamin leh Eker ahi uh.
english: The sons of Ram the firstborn of Jerahmeel were Maaz, Jamin, and Eker.

paite: Onam tapate: Shammai leh Jada ahi uh. Shammai tapate: Nadab leh Abishur ahi uhi.
english: The sons of Onam were Shammai and Jada. The sons of Shammai: Nadab and Abishur.

paite: Abishur zi min Abihail ahi; ama'n Ahban leh Molid asuansak hi.
english: The name of the wife of Abishur was Abihail; and she bore him Ahban and Molid.

paite: Nadab tapate: Seled leh Appaim ahi ua, Seled bel tate nei lou in asi hi.
english: The sons of Nadab: Seled and Appaim; but Seled died without children.

paite: Appaim tapa Ishi ahi. Ishi tapa Sheshan ahi. Sheshan tapa Ahlai ahi.
english: The son of Appaim: Ishi. The son of Ishi: Sheshan. The son of Sheshan: Ahlai.

paite: Huan Shammai unaupa Jada tapate: Jether leh Jonathan ahi ua; Jether ta nei lou in asi hi.
english: The sons of Jada the brother of Shammai: Jether and Jonathan; and Jether died without children.

paite: Huan Jonathan tapate: Peleth, Zaza ahi uh. Hiaite Jerahmeel tapate ahi uh.
english: The sons of Jonathan: Peleth and Zaza. These were the sons of Jerahmeel.

paite: Huchi in Sheshan in, tanute chih louh, tapate anei kei hi. Huan Sheshan in Aigupta mi khat sikha anei a, amin Jarha ahi.
english: Now Sheshan had no sons, but only daughters. Sheshan had a servant, an Egyptian, whose name was Jarha.

paite: Huan Sheshan in asikha Jarha kiang ah zi ding in atanu apia a; huchi in Attai aneihsak hi.
english: Sheshan gave his daughter to Jarha his servant as wife; and she bore him Attai.

paite: Huan Attai in Nathan asuang a, Nathan in Zabad asuang;
english: Attai became the father of Nathan, and Nathan became the father of Zabad,

paite: Zabad in Ephlal asuang; Ephlal in Obed asuang;
english: and Zabad became the father of Ephlal, and Ephlal became the father of Obed,

paite: Obed in Jehu asuang a, Jehu in Azariah asuang;
english: and Obed became the father of Jehu, and Jehu became the father of Azariah,

paite: Azariah in Helez asuang a, Helez in Eleasah asuang hi;
english: and Azariah became the father of Helez, and Helez became the father of Eleasah,

paite: Eleasah in Sisamai asuang a, Sisamai in Shallum asuang;
english: and Eleasah became the father of Sismai, and Sismai became the father of Shallum,

paite: Shallum in Jekamiah asuang a, Jekamiah in Elishama asuang hi.
english: and Shallum became the father of Jekamiah, and Jekamiah became the father of Elishama.

paite: Huchi in Jerahmeel unaupa Kaleb tapate: Ata masapen Mesha ahi a; amah Ziph pa ahi, huan Mareshah ahi a, amah Hebron pa ahi.
heading: Kaleb Suante
english: The sons of Caleb the brother of Jerahmeel were Mesha his firstborn, who was the father of Ziph, and the sons of Mareshah the father of Hebron.

paite: Huan Hebron tapate: Korah, Tappuah, Rekem, Shema ahi uh.
english: The sons of Hebron: Korah, Tappuah, Rekem, and Shema.

paite: Shema in Raham, Jorkoam pa asuang; Rekem in Shammai asuang hi.
english: Shema became the father of Raham, the father of Jorkeam; and Rekem became the father of Shammai.

paite: Huan Shammai tapa Maon ahi; Beth-zur pa Maon ahi.
english: The son of Shammai was Maon; and Maon was the father of Beth Zur.

paite: Ephah, Kaleb mei in, Haran, Moza leh Gazez asuang a: Haran in Gazez asuang hi.
english: Ephah, Caleb’s concubine, bore Haran, Moza, and Gazez; and Haran became the father of Gazez.

paite: Jahdai tapate: Regem, Jotham, Gesan, Pelet, Ephah leh Shaaph ahi uh.
english: The sons of Jahdai: Regem, Jothan, Geshan, Pelet, Ephah, and Shaaph.

paite: Maakah, Kaleb mei in, Sheber leh Tirhanah anei a.
english: Maacah, Caleb’s concubine, bore Sheber and Tirhanah.

paite: Madmannah pa Shaaph, Makbenah pa leh Gibea pa Sheva anei a; Kaleb tanu Aksah ahi.
english: She bore also Shaaph the father of Madmannah, Sheva the father of Machbena and the father of Gibea; and the daughter of Caleb was Achsah.

paite: Hiaite Kaleb tapate ahi uh: Ephrathah ta masapen Hur tapa, Kiriath-jearim pa Shobal;
english: These were the sons of Caleb, the son of Hur, the firstborn of Ephrathah: Shobal the father of Kiriath Jearim,

paite: Bethlehem pa Salma, Bethgader pa Hareph.
english: Salma the father of Bethlehem, and Hareph the father of Beth Gader.

paite: Kiriath-jearim pa Shobal in tapate anei a; Haroeh leh Menaheth kimkhatte ahi ua,
english: Shobal the father of Kiriath Jearim had sons: Haroeh, half of the Menuhoth.

paite: Kiriath-jearim inkote; Ithrit mite, Puthit mite, Shumathit mite, Misrai mite; Zareathit mite leh Eshtaol mite hong kipatna ahi.
english: The families of Kiriath Jearim: the Ithrites, the Puthites, the Shumathites, and the Mishraites; from them came the Zorathites and the Eshtaolites.

paite: Salma tapate: Bethlehem, Netophah mite, Joab inkuante Atroth-beth, Zorit mite, Manahathit mite kimkhatte ahi uh.
english: The sons of Salma: Bethlehem, the Netophathites, Atroth Beth Joab, and half of the Manahathites, the Zorites.

paite: Huan Jabez a teng laigelhmite inkote: Tirathit mite, Shimeathit mite, leh Sukathit mite. Hiaite Ken mi Rekab inkote pa, Hemath a kipan hong paite ahi uhi.
english: The families of scribes who lived at Jabez: the Tirathites, the Shimeathites, and the Sucathites. These are the Kenites who came from Hammath, the father of the house of Rechab.
